scope: Twenty-second bounded target-specific wave: eight current completion-unproved Finance and eMAR targets; four direct CiviCRM recommendations and four conservative retained-unproved outcomes.

methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, deployment or product Git state was changed.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layouts.
methodology.selection_preimage_rule: Ordinal-sorted eight target IDs joined by LF with one terminal LF.
methodology.direct_rule: A recommendation requires target-specific neutral job alignment at pinned official community-source loci. Generic report, company hierarchy or dispense primitives do not inherit audit-package, Site-API or eMAR-workspace credit.
methodology.reuse_rule: Every direct source locus is target-specific and collision-free. Reuse within retained rows is explanatory only and no repository- or family-level inference is allowed.

CIVICRM.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted extensions, payment processors, private deployments and unpinned behavior are excluded.

ERPNEXT.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private extensions and unpinned behavior are excluded.

OPENEMR.edition_boundary: Pinned official community source only; hosted services, private configuration and unpinned behavior are excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Create and update an access-controlled donor contribution with fund classification, lifecycle state and linked financial effects.
evaluations.research_candidate: civicrm/civicrm-core contribution API and canonical contribution processing at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Access-controlled contribution create/update requires contact, amount, date and financial type, prevents duplicates, maintains status and receipt/recurrence fields, persists the record and invokes linked financial-entity processing. This is a bounded donor contribution/fund-classification analogue, not a grant-budget, Site-scope, reconciliation, audit-chain or runtime claim.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Persist donor-fund financial transactions and link them canonically to the originating contribution or supplied entity.
evaluations.research_candidate: civicrm/civicrm-core financial transaction BAO at pinned locus
evaluations.reason: The canonical command creates a financial transaction, preserves its total amount and creates the entity-financial-transaction linkage to the contribution or supplied entity. This does not infer Oblivion allocation, ledger, Site, bank, audit or replay policy.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Report donor contributions by fund classification, status, date and currency with aggregate counts and amounts.
evaluations.research_candidate: civicrm/civicrm-core contribution summary report at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: The contribution report exposes financial-type, status, date and currency filters, joins contacts, contributions and financial types, and calculates contribution count, sum and average by currency. This is a bounded report slice, not fund acquittal, Site policy, audit package or runtime proof.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Summarise financial activity by funding-stream classification with status/date filters, transaction context, totals and drill-down.
evaluations.research_candidate: civicrm/civicrm-core contribution detail report at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Financial-type, status and date filters, financial-transaction and batch joins, currency totals and contribution detail provide a bounded funding-stream summary and drill-down analogue. It does not prove Oblivion funding agreements, allocation controls, Site privacy or runtime.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Generate a governed immutable Finance audit-export package with manifest, hashes, approval/redaction and auditable generation/retry provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: civicrm/civicrm-core contribution summary report at pinned locus
evaluations.reason: An aggregate contribution report does not provide an immutable audit package, package manifest, snapshot hashes, approval/redaction, auditable generation/retry or bundle-download provenance.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Expose an authorised Site-scoped financial summary API with canonical current-caller and direct-object concealment.
evaluations.research_candidate: frappe/erpnext consolidated financial statement at pinned locus
evaluations.reason: A report calculated across a Company hierarchy is not a Site-scoped API summary with current caller authority and direct-object concealment.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Expose an authorised all-Sites financial overview API with bounded cross-Site policy and current data provenance.
evaluations.research_candidate: frappe/erpnext consolidated financial statement at pinned locus
evaluations.reason: A Company-hierarchy report is not an all-Sites financial overview endpoint with Oblivion Site authority, direct-object concealment or current-caller provenance.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Provide a role- and Site-scoped eMAR worker workspace with due/scheduled medication work, safety actions and interaction state.
evaluations.research_candidate: openemr/openemr medication-dispense FHIR services at pinned loci
evaluations.reason: Historical dispense query/mapping and an encounter summary do not provide a medication-worker workspace, due/scheduled worklist, safety action surface, role/Site direct-object workflow or interaction proof.
